posts.zh:
skill-injector-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DSH 会话中自动注入所选技能（如 caveman、ponytail）：每轮提示或仅在会话开始时，含设置页与输入区指示。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-534ed9f9a9e704b238d7.html
posts.en:
skill-injector-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-injects user-chosen skills into DSH sessions, either every prompt or once at session start, with a settings page and a composer indicator.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-534ed9f9a9e704b238d7.html
